criteria.guidance: Look for bowed, kinked or twisted rails; compare continuous rail edges.
criteria.generation_defect: A localized permanent kink midway along the right rail; no other intended defect.

criteria.guidance: Inspect visible rail surfaces for cracks, splits and impact damage; dirt alone is not a crack.
criteria.generation_defect: A visible short branching crack at a rail junction, with material separation rather than a painted line.

criteria.guidance: Visible burrs or splinters may be reported as damage; absence of sharpness requires a person.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly raised metal burr on an exposed rail edge; do not imply a tactile test.

criteria.guidance: Distinguish worn material from cosmetic scuffs and lighting; hidden thickness is unknown.
criteria.generation_defect: Localized deep abrasion with visible material loss on the rail.

criteria.guidance: Wood treatment adequacy cannot be established from colour/shine. Visible peeling is an observation only.
criteria.generation_defect: A wooden ladder rail with peeling coating and exposed wood; treatment adequacy remains unverified.

criteria.guidance: Look for sagged, bent or twisted rungs/steps/platform, retaining an overview for context.
criteria.generation_defect: One rung visibly bent downward at its centre.

criteria.guidance: Look for missing/cracked/broken treads or platform pieces; do not infer occluded parts are present.
criteria.generation_defect: One rung with a clearly broken end and an exposed gap at the rail.

criteria.guidance: Report visible broken edges/splinters, but do not claim tactile smoothness.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly splintered wooden step edge without a person touching it.

criteria.guidance: Inspect visible rung-to-rail interfaces for separation or missing fasteners; no inference about tightness.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly separated rung-to-rail joint with a missing rivet.

criteria.guidance: Inspect tread texture/material loss; reflectance or dust alone is not wear.
criteria.generation_defect: One heavily worn tread with locally flattened anti-slip grooves.

criteria.guidance: Inspect both spreader endpoints and presence. Visible attachment does not prove security.
criteria.generation_defect: One spreader endpoint visibly detached from the rail on an open A-frame.

criteria.guidance: A still image cannot verify operation, locking or load resistance. Default NOT_CHECKED unless literal visible damage supports DEFECT.
criteria.generation_defect: A spreader linkage visibly broken in two; function still not physically tested.

criteria.guidance: Inspect spreader links/straps for visible breaks, bends or tears.
criteria.generation_defect: A visible tear across most of a fabric spreader strap.

criteria.guidance: Describe visible rust, cracks or deformation on hinges/brackets without guessing hidden corrosion.
criteria.generation_defect: Localized flaking corrosion with visible pitting on one steel hinge bracket.

criteria.guidance: Identify visibly absent fittings/fasteners; no torque or tightness claim.
criteria.generation_defect: A hinge mounting hole visibly missing its fastener.

criteria.guidance: Do not claim moving mechanisms function from one or multiple static images.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly snapped hinge pin; no person or motion demonstration.

criteria.guidance: Inspect visible worn guides/hinges/contact faces; play is not inferred without a test.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly elongated hinge mounting hole with worn edges.

criteria.guidance: Neither shine nor a visible smear proves adequate lubrication or mechanism function.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly dirty dry-looking hinge surface, without asserting lubrication failure from appearance alone.

criteria.guidance: Inspect every required foot/roller seen, including rear feet; obscured feet remain unknown.
criteria.generation_defect: One rubber foot cap visibly absent, exposing the rail end.

criteria.guidance: Inspect visible foot-cap tears, tread wear and roller damage; keep ground-contact context.
criteria.generation_defect: A foot cap with a clear split and missing rubber chunk.

criteria.guidance: Grip, brake function and loaded stability require physical checks; apparent floor contact is insufficient.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly fractured roller bracket on an otherwise unchanged platform stepladder.

criteria.guidance: Inspect applicable supports/extensions/stabilizers. Absence alone is not failure unless the required accessory is verified.
criteria.generation_defect: A fitted stabilizer bar visibly detached at one endpoint; show the mounting context.

criteria.guidance: Check instructions/pictograms presence and readable portions. Separate manufacturer data, factory-control dates and inspection sticker due dates.
criteria.generation_defect: A visibly torn instruction/pictogram strip with most safety symbols missing; keep inspection sticker as a separate region.
